title: Retrieval evaluation metrics
content: NeuroFlow retrieval evaluation compares retrieved chunk IDs with manually labelled relevant_chunk_ids. Hit Rate at k measures the fraction of test queries for which at least one relevant chunk appears in the top k results. Mean Reciprocal Rank at k averages the reciprocal of the first relevant result rank, assigning zero when no relevant chunk is retrieved. The benchmark also records P95 retrieval latency in milliseconds. The retrieval benchmark dataset must contain a non-empty query and at least one relevant chunk ID for every example. Evaluation scores must remain unmeasured until real chunk identifiers have been labelled.
